svg.text: Declared geographic extents · WGS84 leg sums · approximate, not observed axes
North Equatorial Current: ≈ 4,400 km · route/gate sensitivity 4,100–4,600 km
South Equatorial Current: ≈ 4,300 km · route/gate sensitivity 3,900–4,500 km
Source context: Philander (2001), Figure 1, July–September schematic. Coordinates are OSW choices.
All72 cases clear the coarse OSW land mask. Fine coast unchecked. Sensitivity is not annual change.
